label: EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE_3: x's represented esse is its represented essence (act identity)
term: existence belongs to the essence, act identity (EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE_3)
definition: EsseIsEssence essenceOf esseOf x := esseOf x = essenceOf x, for the q.3 a.4 represented esse and essence maps (ESSENCE_3): x's essence just is its act of being. An identity of principles with no world index. It is not a predicate or a determination contained in a quiddity, and by itself it says nothing about x at other points.
note: Stipulated for #1887. Sense EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE_3 of the disambiguation f704b7ca-b455-4da7-a757-b0564fe76b3b. The thesis of ST I q.3 a.4 (read, New Advent) and the exception named in De ente c.4 ('unless perhaps there is something whose quiddity is its very own existence', read, Miller translation); analyst formulation, attribution deferred. It reaches essential truth (EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE_2) only through the bridge 565ccd6c-0036-4613-8595-f6f03d273a0d, which factors into the act–fact link and exercise in the nature (docs/notes/existence-in-essence-identity.md).
